listing.name: The Need for Speed (3DO) — pc-theneedforspeed (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Firstactualrace and userwindowplay; allcars/tracks/completion of endurance play has not been confirmed. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 3DO The Need for Speed disc with LaunchMe, frontovl, LMADM and FORMAT. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own disc, generate static ARM code and build pfboot with CMake. Follow the project’s instructions to format blank NVRAM using your own FORMAT, then start with --window. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: Firstactualrace and userwindowplay; allcars/tracks/completion of endurance play has not been confirmed. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
